summary: Westport Fuel Systems Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, attaching a press release dated April 20, 2026, announcing the timing of its Q4 and full-year 2025 financial results release after market close on April 23, 2026, followed by a conference call on April 24, 2026. This is a routine earnings announcement notice, not a special situation event. The filing does not involve any corporate transaction, activist activity, strategic review, or structural change; it is purely an operational update for investors and analysts.
